indexes.//: Required by sendCaregiverExpirationDatesEmails, sendCaregiverAdherenceBelow80Alerts, sendCaregiverWeeklyReports, sendCaregiverMonthlyReports and sendCaregiverNothingRecordedAlerts. Each runs users.where('type','==','C').where('email_reminders','array-contains',<key>) — Firestore cannot serve equality + array-contains from single-field indexes, so without this composite index every one of those scheduled functions throws FAILED_PRECONDITION and no caregiver email is sent at all.
